_comment: LiSenNet NPU CONV variant, capacity-bumped. The nc=16 conv variant (configs/lisennet_conv.json) reached PESQ 2.925 vs the GRU model's 3.006 (-0.081): it has 24% fewer params and its inter-time receptive field is only 240 ms (GRU memory is unbounded). This config closes both gaps while staying NPU-mappable: num_channels 16->20 (41k params, above the GRU's 36.8k), intra_kernel 7->11 (wider bidirectional-over-freq mixing), inter_dilations [1,2,4]->[1,2,4,8] (temporal receptive field 240->496 ms). ~1.56x MACs of nc16, still comfortably real-time. Retrained from scratch into cp_lisennet_conv_wide; A/B against cp_lisennet_conv (2.925). Everything else matches configs/lisennet_conv.json.
